name: softglaze/keepmerge-push-staging-to-live
description: Development tooling for the Keepmerge WordPress plugin: coding standards and the PHPUnit suite. The plugin itself has no PHP dependencies.

scripts.lint: find keepmerge-push-staging-to-live tests tools -name '*.php' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -n1 php -l

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check every PHP file for syntax errors with the current PHP version.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Run PHP_CodeSniffer with phpcs.xml.dist (WordPress, WordPress-Docs, PHPCompatibilityWP 7.4-).
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suite (needs a MySQL database and WordPress core, see README.md).
